author: Life of Boris
description:
BORISTAN is a comedic Slav life sim set in a Soviet town in 1987. Squat, cook, drive a Lada that barely works, and try to find Boris at his kiosk. It's "boristic", not realistic.

Tonight: 8-player co-op on the 0.2 beta, "The town talks". I'll post the room code in chat, so jump in and help Boris raise the Carburettor Fund.

▶ PLAY THE FREE PLAYTEST: https://lifeofboris.itch.io/boristan
Downloading is recommended (Windows, Mac, Linux). The browser version works too, but runs slower.
The playtest ends Sun 8 Nov, 20:00 Eastern European time (EET).

itch.io is only for the playtest. BORISTAN is planned for Steam Early Access.

💬 DISCORD (bug reports, feedback, clips): https://discord.gg/AEHgdjyUyW
In game, press F4 to send a bug report.

NEW IN 0.2 "THE TOWN TALKS"
• Chapter 3 and a new title screen, plus a guided first five minutes
• Five minigames: Tolik's vodka contest, Vadim's AKM range, the pierogi casino, Gena's slap contest, and durak with Babushka (she cheats)
• Anatoli's tuning
title: BORISTAN co-op: 8 comrades, 1 Lada, 0 working carburettors | Slav life sim playtest
